Definition: a species of antelope (probably from the white stripe on the cheek)
BiblicalUsage: The word is the wild ox, the wild bull. It is named among the clean beasts Israel might eat, and Isaiah says the sons of Jerusalem lie at the head of all the streets, as a wild bull in a net, full of the fury of the Lord.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the wild bull in the net is Jerusalem herself, strong but caught, and only the Lord can loose her.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
